title: Nearside of Earth's Moon as Seen by the Clementine Spacecraft
mission: DSPSE (Deep Space Program Science Experiment), spacecraft Clementine 1, Ultraviolet/Visible Camera
sourceDescription: About 50,000 Clementine images were processed to produce the four orthographic views of the Moon. The images show albedo variations (normalized brightness or reflectivity) of the surface at a wavelength of 750 nm (just longward of visible red).

what: A mosaic of about 50,000 Clementine frames in an orthographic projection, not one exposure: the albedo at 750 nm, with the disc filling the frame (the limb touches its four edges), maria and craters, and no photon-noise floor a CCD frame has. It carries no pixel-unit, gain, linearity or saturation documentation, so it is a display image and a real-data test of decode, draw and repeatability, never a calibrated measurement.
